title: Epidemiology of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: A Review

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Epidemiology of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: A Review》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Triple-negative breast cancer accounted for 12% of breast cancers diagnosed in the United States from 2012 to 2016, with a 5-year survival 8% to 16% lower than hormone receptor-positive disease.

evidence.text: Triple-negative breast cancer accounted for 12% of breast cancers diagnosed in the United States from 2012 to 2016, with a 5-year survival 8% to 16% lower than hormone receptor-positive disease.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Epidemiology of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: A Review》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】To level the playing field, we must integrate genomic predictors of disease and epidemiologic characteristics of molecular breast cancer subtypes to provide personalized risk assessment, screening, and treatment for each patient.
